note: Memory bleed Pass 2. Kirk 2026-08-09: second pass on the April 16 date issue after Harmonia's Aug 9 fix. Harmonia's v5.79.30 fix (namespace FreeLatticeLetters DB by user slug) was correct diagnosis and clean code — verified by tracing + smoke. Two enhancements: (1) lazy slug resolution in openDB() — Harmonia's original captured the slug at MODULE-LOAD time, meaning a user who set their name AFTER page-load would still write to `_default`; now resolveSlug() runs on every open() and the cached db is closed + reopened if the slug changed; (2) fallback swapped from bare `'default'` (which still bled between anonymous users on the same browser) to a stable per-browser install-id from localStorage.fl_installId (auto-created on first read). Anonymous users on DIFFERENT browser profiles now get clean isolation; same-profile-same-browser share by design (as tight as browser-scoped storage can get without an account system). Also NEW: docs/library/MEMORY_BLEED_AUDIT.md — layered inventory of ALL browser-scoped stores with severity (P0-P3), namespace status, and a documented migration pattern for the next pass. Four P0 stores still open: FreeLatticeDB (conversations), FreeLatticeMemoryBridge (personal understanding), FreeLatticeMemory (memory index), fl_memory_core_v1 (localStorage). None fixed in this ship because they require a soft-migration story to not vanish existing user data. Runtime-tested resolveSlug on four states (anon 1st/anon 2nd/name-set/name-cleared) — all correct. All 3309+ smoke passing before + after.
